title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 907 Fourth Avenue in Lake Odessa, Michigan, as the "Donna Sauers Besko Post Office".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 907 Fourth Avenue in Lake Odessa, Michigan, as the "Donna Sauers Besko Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named the Postal Service building at 907 Fourth Avenue in Lake Odessa, Michigan, the "Donna Sauers Besko Post Office."
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a specific post office building in Lake Odessa, Michigan, a new official name honoring Donna Sauers Besko. It changes only the name of the facility. It does not change mail service, postal rules, or how the building operates.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018.
